properties.verseOrder: v1 v2 v3 v4 v5 v6

verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
ERINNYA lya Yesu ddungi
Eri akkiriza;
Lisangula-amaziga ge,
Limalamu-okutya.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Litereeza n'omwoyo gwe
Linyiga-ebiwundu;
Ye mmere y'omuyala-,era
Liwumuza-akooye.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Erinnya gganzi, lwe lwazi
Kwe nzimba-enju yange
Lye ggwanika-eritaggwaamu
Emirembe gyonna.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Musumba wange,nkwebaza,
Mulokozi wange;
Bulamu bwange,nkwebaza,
Era-ekkubo lyange.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Okufuba kwange kwonna
Tekuliimu maanyi;
Naye bwe ndikulabako,
Ndikutendereza.

verse.name: v6
verse.lines:
Onteegeezenga bulijjo,
Ekisa kyo-ekingi
Erinnya lyo linsanyuse
Mu ntuuko-ez'okufa
